title: Weighted Fruit Diophantine Equations and Hyperelliptic Curves
summary: We study the weighted fruit Diophantine equation $ax^{d} - c\bigl(m^{2}y^{2}+n^{2}z^{2}\bigr) + xyz - b = 0$, generalising previous work by Majumdar--Sury, Vaishya--Sharma, and Prakash--Chakraborty. Subject to specific hypotheses on the parameters, our main result shows that for any prime $l \equiv 3 \pmod 4$ and $b = a (2 c m n)^{d} - l\, c^{s}t^{2q}$, the above equation has no integer solutions except for certain residue classes of $x$ modulo $4l$. An analogous result also holds when $l$ is replaced by an odd power of $l$ in the definition of $b$. We prove some insolvability results for…
